bps_per_trade.description: Basis points of the value traded, charged on every trade: 10 is 0.1%.
bps_per_trade.title: Bps Per Trade

FilterSpec.description: A condition every holding must meet at a decision, such as rev_accel > 0.

signal.description: The ID of a signal in `signals`.
signal.title: Signal

FilterSpec.title: FilterSpec

MacroChangeSignal.description:
A macro series' change over its latest releases, as published by the decision.
It's the same for every security, so a filter on it holds securities only while the
economy meets a condition, such as unemployment falling.

series.description: A series in the macro catalog, such as "UNRATE", the unemployment rate.
series.title: Series

releases.description:
How many releases back the change starts: 3 compares the latest observation with
the one three months before it, or three quarters for a quarterly series. At most
120.
releases.title: Releases

change.description:
"absolute" subtracts, in the series' units, such as percentage points for UNRATE.
"relative" divides: 0.03 is 3%.
change.title: Change

MacroChangeSignal.title: MacroChangeSignal

MomentumSignal.description:
The total return over a lookback, leaving out the most recent months: 12-1 by
default.

lookback_months.description:
How many months back the return starts: 12, the default, for 12-1 momentum. At
most 120.
lookback_months.title: Lookback Months

skip_months.description:
How many of the latest months to leave out: 1, the default, for 12-1 momentum.
Fewer than `lookback_months`.
skip_months.title: Skip Months

MomentumSignal.title: MomentumSignal

PeriodSpec.description: The dates the backtest covers, both included.
PeriodSpec.title: PeriodSpec

PortfolioSpec.description: How the securities that pass the filters are weighted.
PortfolioSpec.title: PortfolioSpec

ScheduleSpec.description: When decisions are made, and when their trades fill.

decision.description:
The first trading day of each month at a New York time, such as the default,
"first_trading_day 09:30 America/New_York".
decision.title: Decision

fill.description:
"same_day_close", the default, fills at the decision day's close, and
"next_day_open" at the next session's open. Either comes strictly after the
decision.
fill.title: Fill
